frame.origin: centre of the tunnel turntable on the floor plane (MP_caseM.png 'Origin'; its ground surface is at z = 33.07 m)
frame.x: +x NORTH (compass rose of MP_caseM.png: N at +x)
frame.y: +y WEST (W at +y); the frame is right-handed
frame.z: +z up from the TUNNEL FLOOR, full scale; the campus ground lies at z ~ 32 m (terrain 3.6 ... 36 m); every point is 3 m above the local ground
frame.wind_direction_rotation: meteorological FROM-direction (N = 0, E = 90, S = 180): 180 deg blows toward +x (north); flow_dir = (-cos WD, +sin WD), so WD > 180 turns the wind toward -y. Measured: the plume's lateral centroid moves toward -y as WD grows in the tunnel (175 -> 185 deg) and across the field runs, and the compass rose of MP_caseM.png agrees.
frame.length_scale: FULL-scale metres (model 1:600): tunnel coordinates and the STL are multiplied by 600; velocities and concentrations are NOT scaled

files.format: ASCII STL, LF, metres, same frame as points.csv
files.source: BD_caseM.stl (Zenodo; terrain + buildings of the Atsugi campus) scaled x600 from model to full-scale metres and re-wound outward; 43936 triangles, one shell, 21 boundary and 7 non-manifold edges; z = 0 is the tunnel floor, the campus ground lies at z ~ 32 m
